treasury.verified_evidence: Official indexed FS Policy 901-1 defines Open Data as public data and Open Source Data as free to use and download in publicly readable formats. July 2021 issue/review; next review July 2025. API response was acquired without credentials and contains complete metadata for 17 rows.
treasury.limitations: Direct official API documentation/about/policy fetches returned 403 in web on 2026-10-07. Full current license-and-authorization wording and later policy revisions were not independently retrieved; no substitute third-party licensing assertion is adopted. No attempt was made to bypass denial.
treasury.prior_terms_do_not_apply_automatically: TreasuryDirect web-api terms previously disclosed belong to a separate service; this source is FiscalData.
treasury.attribution: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service; Fiscal Data, Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities

usgs.verified_via: Official page content retrieved by web tool; direct HTTP document fetch returned empty 202 and is preserved as failed document evidence.
usgs.conditions: USGS-authored or produced data/information are in the U.S. public domain; proper credit is requested. Third-party material may have separate rights; this capture contains numerical catalog data, not photographs, trademarks or media.
usgs.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program, ComCat catalog
usgs.no_guarantee: Catalog events may be revised; exact captured bytes, not a future live re-query, define this offline input.

census.verified_via: Official source page and policies retrieved via web tool; official CSV and layout PDF retrieved by anonymous bounded HTTP GET.
census.conditions: Census publishes public datasets as open data and supports reuse and reproducibility. DS027 page 9 states Census employee works generally lack U.S. copyright protection, with foreign and nonemployee-work qualifications. Cite the source. Aggregate state-level population estimates do not identify respondents. No rights are claimed over agency marks.
census.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Division; Vintage 2025 NST-EST2025-ALLDATA, released January 2026
census.api_failure_handling: The Census API returned Missing Key HTML. It is excluded as a dataset. The successful file is separately offered as a public CSV on an official download page, not a bypass of the API key requirement.
